sin.name: approval-without-its-command
sin.description: A UserApprovalRefusal names no command, so Accept re-runs the line the agent ran, with the flags the agent gave it, and the handler or guard has to ask the actor again.
sin.rule: Name the command Accept runs: UserApprovalRefusal(question, command=ResumeAgent(agent.id)); Accept runs exactly that command as the person.
